s0.en: There are {n} spins, from left to right: {spins}. Each spin is 1 or -1. There is one pass, from left to right. An interior spin has two neighbors, and an end spin has one. A spin flips when its sign is opposite the sum of its neighbors. A neighbor that has already flipped is used later in the pass. The energy is minus the sum of products of neighboring spins. How many spins flipped?
